summary_en: 150,000 shares (1.8% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥500M upper limit, open-market purchase via Tokyo Stock Exchange, 18 June – 12 August 2026. Board resolved framework on 17 June 2026; actual execution subject to financial position, share price and market conditions.
title_en: Notice Regarding Authorization Framework for Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: AlbaLink's board of directors resolved on 17 June 2026 to establish a framework for the acquisition of up to 150,000 treasury shares (1.8% of outstanding shares, excluding treasury) with a maximum aggregate expenditure of ¥500 million, pursuant to the Companies Act Section 459(1) and the company's articles of association Article 36. Acquisition will occur through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from 18 June to 12 August 2026. The board states the company believes its future profitability is not fully reflected in the current share price, and intends to respond flexibly to market conditions while controlling the effective cost of future capital allocation policies. The resolution establishes only a framework; actual acquisition, timing and scale will be determined based on financial position, share price levels and broader market environment. As of 31 May 2026, the company held no treasury shares against 8,183,600 shares outstanding.
